changes.title: The 1-frame physics delay on jumping, double-jump cancelling, and air dodging has finally been fixed!
changes: These actions now give momentum instantly, making movement feel significantly more responsive
As a result of these fixes, jumping from the ground now lasts 1 less frame of total air time
Even though jumps apply momentum frame 1, they retain the exact same maximum jump height.
Furthermore, this may have a noticeable effect on characters’ actionability out of short hop aerials, and will impact areas like auto-cancel timing windows for the time being.

changes.title: Wall-bouncing during knockback from a meteor no longer stops a character from meteor canceling
Windboxes no longer completely override existing knockback
Characters now enter teeter when reaching a ledge after a wavedash or special landing, matching Melee behavior. Hold forward on the control stick to override this and slide off instead.
Special Versus option added: Final Smash meter!
changes: Charge up a Final Smash while dealing damage, filling a meter indicated by a new graphic beneath each character's stock icons.
Only one character can have a Final Smash at a time, and the meter clears upon being KO'd, so use it before it's gone!
This replaces War mode as a Special Versus option.

moves.title: Systems

changes.title: P+ now supports asynchronous result screen portrait loading on the Character Select Screen!
changes: Years in the making, this long-awaited modding advancement removes the need for compressed character portraits to be stored in the CSS menu, allowing for greater freedom when adding character costumes.
Thanks to ARSP, about 3 MB of duplicate image data has been removed!
As various filesize restrictions no longer apply, many portraits no longer need color-smashing compression, allowing for higher-quality images on console.

changes.title: Some necessary file & memory accommodations have been made for ARSP
changes: Character .pac files now load during Stage Select instead of when chosen on Character Select
Reduced maximum memory allocation of the results screen via Results.param
Event Match .param files that read from L+Start or R+Start stage files instead use dedicated Event_xx.param files to avoid being accidentally overwritten by custom edits.
Dolphin launchers now attempt to locate a .gct codeset file in every sub-folder on the SD root (except apps and private), removing the need to set a build path specifically for it
Hackless .bin now uses a build path set by a corresponding text file in the private/wii/app/RSBE folder

changes.title: Added optional codes to the Extras folder. These can be enabled for custom builds inside More.asm:
changes: AnimationBlend, an experimental edit for smoother transitions between character animations in certain cases (affects gameplay)
